name: Almagro (Spain)
description: White field charged at the centre with a red cross of Calatrava bearing a small shield of the town, above two fetterlocks.
history: Municipal flag of Almagro; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: cross of Calatrava with a shield at its centre and two fetterlocks beneath
